productCreateInput.title: Mysore Sandalwood & Amber
productCreateInput.descriptionHtml:
"Sacred temple woods, golden amber resin, and grounding cardamom."

The Olfactive Journey

Centuries ago along the Kaveri river basin, sandalwood carvers filled Mysore courts with deep meditative smoke. We sourced ethically managed aged sandalwood roots and infused them with slow-aged golden amber resin to invoke peace and mindful focus in modern living spaces.

Scent Architecture

  • Top Notes: Sun-dried Cardamom Pods • Bergamot Rind • Frankincense Tears
  • Heart Notes: Aged Mysore Sandalwood Bark • Smoked Cedarwood • Papyrus Reed
  • Base Notes: Golden Amber Resin • Tahitian Vanilla • Cashmere Musk

An ode to ancient South Indian temple sanctuaries, blending royal Mysore sandalwood with soothing cardamom and sacred balsamic ambers.

Artisan Specifications

Wax Formulation: 100% Golden Botanical Soy Wax
Wick: Dual Lead-Free Braided Egyptian Cotton
Vessel Design: Handcrafted Fluted Amber Glass with Teakwood Lid
Dimensions: 8.5 cm Dia x 10 cm H
Burn Time: 55+ Hours (200g) / 80+ Hours (450g)
Provenance: Artisan hand-poured in micro-batches, Bengaluru, India

The Lighting Ritual

The First Burn: Burn uninterrupted for 3 to 4 hours on your first session until the golden liquid pool touches all four glass rims. This programs the memory of the soy wax and prevents tunneling.

Maintenance: Trim wicks to 5mm (1/4 inch) before each lighting. This preserves a whisper-clean, smokeless golden flame and extends candle longevity.

Vessel Rebirth: When 1/2 inch wax remains, pour hot water into the glass. The wax will float to the top and pop out upon cooling. Wash with mild soap and repurpose as an earthen succulent planter or tea light holder.

productCreateInput.title: Kashmir Saffron & Oudh
productCreateInput.descriptionHtml:
"Hand-harvested Pampore saffron threads steeped in dark royal oudh and warm leather."

The Olfactive Journey

High in the plateaus of Pampore, saffron blossoms bloom for only two weeks each autumn. Blended with distillations of wild fallen agarwood from Assam, this candle encapsulates aristocratic warmth and royal Indian evening celebrations.

Scent Architecture

  • Top Notes: Crimson Saffron Threads • Blood Orange Zest • Pink Peppercorn
  • Heart Notes: Assam Smoked Oudh • Damask Rose Otto • Spiced Nutmeg
  • Base Notes: Dark Patchouli • Birch Tar • Labdanum Resin • Roasted Tonka

An intoxicating regal perfume evoking Mughal garden twilight, blending rare Kashmiri saffron threads with smoky wild Assam agarwood and velvety Damask roses.

Artisan Specifications

Wax Formulation: 100% Golden Botanical Soy Wax
Wick: Dual Lead-Free Braided Cotton Wick
Vessel Design: Matte Charcoal Ceramic with Burnished Brass Lid
Dimensions: 8.8 cm Dia x 10.2 cm H
Burn Time: 55+ Hours (200g) / 80+ Hours (450g)
Provenance: Artisan hand-poured in micro-batches, Bengaluru, India

The Lighting Ritual

The First Burn: Allow 3 full hours on the first light. Soy wax possesses scent memory; complete surface liquefaction prevents tunneling on future evenings.

Maintenance: Before relighting, snip the burnt mushroom carbon head to 5mm to avoid flickering and soot.

Vessel Rebirth: Clean the charcoal ceramic vessel with hot water and use it as an elegant desk caddy, brush holder, or keepsake canister.

productCreateInput.title: Malabar Vanilla & Cinnamon
productCreateInput.descriptionHtml:
"Heirloom Malabar coast Ceylon cinnamon bark roasted with bourbon vanilla and creamy tonka."

The Olfactive Journey

The ancient spice ports of Kerala traded fragrant quills of genuine Ceylon cinnamon and pungent cardamom across oceans. We combined sun-dried cinnamon bark with rich organic vanilla bean for a restorative, fireside bakery warmth.

Scent Architecture

  • Top Notes: Crushed Ceylon Cinnamon • Star Anise • Grated Ginger Root
  • Heart Notes: Bourbon Vanilla Pod • Clove Buds • Steamed Oat Milk
  • Base Notes: Brown Sugar Glaze • Warm Amber • Creamy Sandalwood

A comforting sanctuary aroma inspired by sun-cured spice spice plantations along the Malabar coastline, infused with golden vanilla bean and warming winter spices.

Artisan Specifications

Wax Formulation: 100% Golden Botanical Soy Wax
Wick: Dual Lead-Free Braided Cotton Wick
Vessel Design: Warm Terracotta Glazed Earthenware with Wood Lid
Dimensions: 8.5 cm Dia x 9.8 cm H
Burn Time: 55+ Hours (200g) / 80+ Hours (450g)
Provenance: Artisan hand-poured in micro-batches, Bengaluru, India

The First Burn: Light on a cozy rainy evening and let the full top layer liquefy across 3 hours.

Maintenance: Keep wick trimmed to 5mm to prevent soot.

Vessel Rebirth: Clean wax residue with hot water and use the terracotta pot for spices or desk stationery.

productCreateInput.title: Darjeeling Tea & Bergamot
productCreateInput.descriptionHtml:
"First-flush misty Himalayan tea leaves elevated with sun-drenched Italian bergamot."

The Olfactive Journey

In the crisp spring air of Darjeeling, first-flush tea leaves are hand-plucked at dawn while mist still shrouds the Kanchenjunga peaks. This clean, revitalizing blend brings mental clarity and uplift to work desks and reading studies.

Scent Architecture

  • Top Notes: Italian Bergamot • Crisp Lemon Zest • Crushed Mint Leaf
  • Heart Notes: First-Flush Darjeeling Black Tea • White Thyme • Dewy Neroli
  • Base Notes: Clary Sage • Himalayan Vetiver Root • Sheer Musk

Luminous morning mist over terraced Himalayan tea gardens, woven with sparkling citrus zest and gentle aromatic herbs.

Artisan Specifications

Wax Formulation: 100% Golden Botanical Soy Wax
Wick: Dual Lead-Free Braided Cotton Wick
Vessel Design: Frosted Sage Green Glass with Raw Bamboo Lid
Dimensions: 8.5 cm Dia x 9.8 cm H
Burn Time: 55+ Hours (200g) / 80+ Hours (450g)
Provenance: Artisan hand-poured in micro-batches, Bengaluru, India

The Lighting Ritual

The First Burn: Burn for 3 hours during quiet morning work hours to establish an even melt pool.

Maintenance: Trim wick to 1/4 inch before relighting.

Vessel Rebirth: Repurpose the frosted sage glass as an iced matcha glass or small flower vase.

productCreateInput.title: Mogra & Star Jasmine
productCreateInput.descriptionHtml:
"Sweet evening-blooming Madurai mogra garlands intertwined with dew-kissed star jasmine."

The Olfactive Journey

In Madurai, jasmine flowers are picked when closed as dusk approaches, opening only at nightfall to release their most concentrated ethereal perfume. This candle recreates the scent of festive courtyards adorned with fresh mogra garlands.

Scent Architecture

  • Top Notes: Green Ivy Tendrils • Morning Dewdrops • Neroli Blossom
  • Heart Notes: Madurai Mogra (Arabian Jasmine) • Night-Blooming Jasmine • Ylang-Ylang
  • Base Notes: White Sandalwood Silk • Soft Amber • Pure Benzoin

The intoxicating midnight bloom of Tamil Nadu mogra flower markets, celebrating the sacred, joyful beauty of Indian wedding nights and festive evenings.

Artisan Specifications

Wax Formulation: 100% Golden Botanical Soy Wax
Wick: Dual Lead-Free Braided Cotton Wick
Vessel Design: Glossy Warm Alabaster Glass with Gold Foil Stamp
Dimensions: 8.5 cm Dia x 10 cm H
Burn Time: 55+ Hours (200g) / 80+ Hours (450g)
Provenance: Artisan hand-poured in micro-batches, Bengaluru, India

The Lighting Ritual

The First Burn: Light before twilight gatherings and let it burn for 3 to 4 hours to ensure an optimal melt pool.

Maintenance: Snip wick to 5mm before every relight.

Vessel Rebirth: Clean out with warm water and use as a stunning makeup brush holder or bathroom vanity organizer.

productCreateInput.title: Monsoon Petrichor & Vetiver
productCreateInput.descriptionHtml:
"The unforgettable aroma of parched earth meeting the first drops of Indian monsoon rain (Mitti Attar)."

The Olfactive Journey

In the ancient perfume capital of Kannauj, hydro-distillation of baked alluvial earth into sandalwood oil creates Mitti Attar—the scent of rain. We combined genuine clay distillates with earthy Khus vetiver roots to capture the emotional relief of India’s first monsoon showers.

Scent Architecture

  • Top Notes: Ozone Rain Mist • Crushed Lemongrass • Wet Peat Moss
  • Heart Notes: Baked Indian Mitti (Clay Attar) • Himalayan Pine Needle • Lotus Leaf
  • Base Notes: Roots of Khus (Wild Vetiver) • Damp Oakmoss • Cedar Resin

The poetic scent of Kannauj mitti attar, capturing that ecstatic breath when summer’s first raindrops strike sun-baked red soil.

Artisan Specifications

Wax Formulation: 100% Golden Botanical Soy Wax
Wick: Dual Lead-Free Braided Cotton Wick
Vessel Design: Smokey Amber Glass Jar with Cork Lid
Dimensions: 8.5 cm Dia x 10 cm H
Burn Time: 55+ Hours (200g) / 80+ Hours (450g)
Provenance: Artisan hand-poured in micro-batches, Bengaluru, India

The Lighting Ritual

The First Burn: Burn for 3–4 hours while reading or unwinding in the evening to achieve full edge-to-edge melt pool.

Maintenance: Trim cotton wick to 5mm to keep flame steady and smoke-free.

Vessel Rebirth: Wash with warm soapy water and use as an indoor herb planter or incense holder.
